title: Advertisement for Selection to Vacant Posts of Uniformed Constables (Group 'C') in Various Departments of Uttarakhand
application_fee: Rs. 300 for General/OBC, Rs. 150 for SC/ST/EWS/PwBD, Exempted for Orphans
age_limit: Varies by post (18-25, 18-30, 18-35, 21-35 years) as of 01 July 2026. Age relaxation applicable for reserved categories.
summary: The Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) has released an advertisement for the direct recruitment of 1694 uniformed constables (Group 'C') across various departments in Uttarakhand. Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website from November 25, 2026, with the application deadline set for December 25, 2026. The selection process involves a physical standard and efficiency test followed by a written competitive examination.
eligibility_bullets: Minimum educational qualification is Intermediate (12th Pass) or equivalent from a recognized board.

Age limits vary by post: 18-25 years for Police, PAC/IRB, Fireman, Forest Guard, Special Tiger Guards; 21-35 years for Jail Guard; 18-30 years for Secretariat Guard and Transport Constable; 18-35 years for Excise Constable. Age is calculated as of July 01, 2026, with relaxations for reserved categories.
Candidates must meet prescribed physical standards including height and chest measurements, and pass a physical efficiency test.
Preference will be given to candidates with at least two years of service in the Territorial Army or an 'B' or 'C' certificate from the National Cadet Corps (NCC).
